title: [FE] UI/UX QA Fixes — Approvals Widget & Approvals Journey

walkthroughSteps.body: Each pending request has an actions menu with Approve, Reject, and View details.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Each approval request row has Approve, Reject, and View details actions

preconditions.text: At least one approval row with an actions menu is visible

expectedUI.description: Row actions menu with Approve/Reject/View details
visualCues: Menu offers Approve, Reject, View details

howToTest.trigger: Click the row actions kebab on an approval request
